name: L19.name
idea: Bombs, fuses, cannons and fireworks betray you

trolls.name: The bomb at the wall is lit as you come
The dud bomb is not a dud
The lit bomb blows the bridge away
The firework rains sparks all around
The cannon fires you where its barrel points
The cannonball ricochets back at you
The mortar aims where you will be
The barrels go off one after another
The pinwheel sweeps the floor with sparks
The birthday cake is a firework cake
A giant bomb is lit next to you
The fuse on the bridge burns to the keg under it
The fuse forks to a keg behind the shelter
The sparkler lights the fuses you walk over
The mortar shoots holes into the bridge
